 Rural Health, Inc. Sets “Night of the Living Health Fair 5” for October 23
 WMOK – Anna, IL – Rural Health, Inc. will host its annual “Night of the Living Health Fair 5” trick-or-treat event on Friday, October 23, 2026. 
 This year’s theme is “Movie Monsters and TV Terrors”. The community event will run from 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM at 513 N. Main Street in Anna, Illinois. 
 Event highlights include: 
 * Free Health Resources: Access to health information and community wellness tools. 
 * Trick-or-Treating: Free candy distribution for attendees. 
 * Activities & Refreshments: Fall-themed games along with food and beverages available for purchase. 
 Financial support for the project is provided by the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
